mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increase aspirin accumulation and toxicity risk, while aspirin may potentiate renal injury.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and aspirin levels closely; consider alternative antiplatelet agent if high-dose amphotericin B is required; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
